items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: And one of the guys who was on a lot of those dates was a piano player. He arranged a lot. And he died very young and very early -- Clyde Hart.

ctx.x: Like I never played regularly with guys like Parker or Dizzy -- or not a steady job regularly all the time with them, but I did a lot of recordings with them, so this meant a lot. In fact, one of Dizzy's most popular recordings -- I was on it there in New York, and this was a record of 'Can't Get Started; Don Basas and myself are on that record.
And one of the guys who was on a lot of those dates was a piano player. He arranged a lot. And he died very young and very early -- Clyde Hart. You probably heard a lot of Clyde.
